method: Re-read GitHub audit JSONs v189/v190/v191 and recompute consistency assertions. Distinguish v102 national self-loop statistics from v129/v140 candidate incidence: identical numeric totals across versions do not establish edge identity.

identityGate.reason: v102 and v129/v140 are distinct dataset versions. Equality of 61 zero-length self-loop counts does not prove they refer to the same 61 edges; neither 490/705 nor 3/204 establishes a verified cross-version subset.
requiredEvidence: For each v102 and v129 self-loop, extract mountain code, stable source feature ID (if present), full source polyline coordinates, length and endpoint IDs.
Compare original SHP feature identifiers and geometry hashes under explicit CRS and coordinate precision; record one-to-one matches, additions, removals and changed topology.
Only then classify 61 zero-length records and 3 >10m candidate loops as same-edge matches or distinct observations.
